body: Resolved PacketVoxelData/PacketDisconnect=4 type ID conflict. Added VoxelChunkCache (32 slots), net_apply_voxel_packet parser, net_tick handler, draw_voxel_chunks retro renderer (log=brown/amber, leaf=forest green). Protocol.h updated with PACKET_VOXEL_DATA=4, PACKET_IMPACT=5, PACKET_SCENE_CHANGE=6, VoxelChunkCache typedef. Go server builds clean.
title: Bridge spec: voxel chunk rendering in C client
